profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Yamaha Motor Corporation, USA
profile.summary:
I am a full stack senior software engineer, with 10 years of professional experience.  I am passionate about quality, efficiency, productivity and professionalism in a team environment.  Every team I've been on, I have helped develop a culture that embraces a disciplined Agile-like test-driven development process that ensures that we meet deadlines for the business partners and stakeholders.  I believe that building a positive and helpful environment for my teammates helps produce happy teammates that build the best quality products.

I am currently a Senior Software Engineer & Team Lead at Yamaha's Marine Innovation Center in Kennesaw, Georgia (joined 2025), helping build GUIs for boats, WaveRunners, and outboards, as well as integrated software for MFDs, using a variety of technologies, including Python, React, Docker, and Cursor AI-powered IDE.  Yamaha is an awesome company to work for, especially because we get to test our products on the water!  

Before joining Yamaha in 2025, was working for a microchip-configuration software company called ChipFoundry (previously known as Efabless) as a software development team lead from 2017 to 2025.  And Verenia CPQ as a software engineer from 2016-2017.

Strong:  Python, React, TypeScript, AI-Model Training, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, SQL, HTML/CSS, Flask, SQLAlchemy, Selenium, Playwright, RobotFramework, AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, Route 53, OpenSearch), JIRA, Git, CI/CD, TDD, Web API Design & Integrations, UI/UX Design

Experienced: Docker, PHP, CodeIgniter, Node.js, MongoDB, Angular, D3, Redux, GitHub Copilot, TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Customer-facing helm, engine-control, and connected-boat software for Sport Boat, WaveRunner, Outboard, and boat-stabilization products (React/TypeScript + Python/Flask).
•  Sole owner of latest Sport Boat multi-display helm software: React/TypeScript UI, Python/Flask APIs and integrations, reusable components, and Docker packaging.  Delivered a month early for an August 2026 on-water, multi-display live demo; ran UAT with stakeholders and supported post-demo fixes.
•  Built WaveRunner and Outboard full-stack features (reusable UI, REST/MQTT APIs, Docker pipelines, GitHub Actions) and Python automation for connected-boat / boat-stabilization cloud integrations.  Practiced TDD (30+ pytest suites, 25+ Playwright e2e specs) with a green suite as the merge gate.
•  Created a collaborative lightweight delivery cadence process on a small cross-functional team — ticket-linked git, sprint estimates, ship-ready slices, peer review, and docs — so committed work actually finished.

positions.title: Software Development Team Lead
positions.description:
• Led team with a hybrid of Agile/XP, iterative, feature-driven, and waterfall methodologies, managing cross-functional projects with weekly deployment cycles.
• Led the full project lifecycle for the architecture, development, and deployment of efabless.com, a git-based chip design platform.  Successfully delivered to over 15,000 users worldwide, driving platform adoption and growth.
•  Spearheaded Agile Extreme Programming (XP) practices, implementing weekly feature-driven releases concurrently with daily bug-fix deployments, and aligning development priorities with COO and SVP of Business Development to ensure rapid iteration and responsiveness to market needs in a fast-paced startup.
•  Managed and mentored an international, cross-functional team, including a senior architect, cloud infrastructure engineer, and offshore contractors.  Optimized team performance through clear communication, process improvements, automation, and effective delegation, ensuring on-time delivery within budget constraints.
•  Orchestrated the full development lifecycle, including JIRA ticketing, test-driven development (RobotFramework), code reviews, QA, and deployment via AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, Route 53).  Streamlined processes to improve efficiency and reduce deployment time by 93%, while maintaining high code quality.
•  Maintained a 300+ automated test suite ensuring zero-regression in weekly releases and implemented AWS OpenSearch logging for real-time bug analysis and user flow diagnostics.
•  Served as both Project Lead and Individual Contributor, effectively balancing strategic oversight with hands-on problem-solving to overcome development bottlenecks and accelerate critical feature delivery with a small cohesive team.
•  Championed engineering team motivation and communication, fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture across distributed teams.  Ensured project alignment across stakeholders, mitigating risks, and maintaining focus on key objectives.
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Python (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Developed CPQ sales-automation software for companies with complex products, focusing on building, implementing, and deploying software.
• Acted as a liaison for business associates, translating requirements and providing estimates to offshore developers.
• Overhauled user interface to enhance sales-people and business partners' experience.
• Automated upselling/cross-selling notifications and email processes, improving efficiency and customer engagement.

positions.title: Account Executive
positions.description:
Responsible for sourcing new business, selling annual subscriptions of cloud-based legal practice management software
* Helped achieve all-time monthly sales records in September and October 2015, locking in over $108,000 in annual subscription revenue
* Formulated plans with software engineers and clients to create custom software solutions
* Delivered live custom demonstrations on Join.me application software based on client specific needs
* Worked strategically with sales team to navigate large complex law firms and identify business units and key decision makers to drive opportunities for new business

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
• Led sales team to more than double annual sales from $265,000 in 2013 to $547,000 in 2014.
• Managed two salespeople through entire sales cycle, focusing on high ROI accounts in manufacturing, maintenance, and construction industries.
• Strengthened strategic growth plan by coaching new-hires towards aggressive demand creation and market capture.
